README: The arena's own answers about the site it renders. whiteout/site.py reads
this and never opens a socket; scripts/arena_site.py is the only thing that
talks to the arena, and it rewrites this file only when asked with --write.
Each record holds the response as the arena sent it, under 'response', with
a note beside it saying where that answer came from. A record whose
'response' is null has never been fetched: leave it null rather than
filling it in from a slide, which is what PR #102 exists to undo.
One exception to 'as the arena sent it': /api/env returns the organisers'
whole .env, credentials included, and this repository is public. Any key
that looks like a credential has its value replaced with a note saying so.
The key stays visible; the secret never lands here.

env.body:
# Copy to .env and edit. Everything downstream keys off these.

# --- Site --------------------------------------------
# Any land above 60°N works: terrain comes from ArcticDEM, 
# imagery from Sentinel-2. Both are fetched on demand for 
# these coordinates.
SITE_NAME=fort_ross
SITE_LAT=71.991960
SITE_LON=-94.822428

# Square footprint in metres of real ground, and heightmap
# resolution. SITE_GRID must be 2^n+1: 513, 1025, 2049. 
# 1025 over 6500 m is ~6.3 m/sample.
SITE_EXTENT=6500
SITE_GRID=1025

# --- Imagery --------------------------------------------
# Polar night has no light, so only summer months 
# yield usable scenes.
IMAGERY_MONTHS=6,7,8
IMAGERY_CLOUD=5

# Sentinel-2 is 10 m, so a 6.5 km site holds only ~650 px 
# of real optical detail. ArcticDEM publishes a 2 m mosaic
# — 5x finer — and its high-frequency hillshade is mixed 
# in to add genuine micro-relief the imagery cannot resolve.
IMAGERY_DETAIL=1
IMAGERY_DETAIL_STRENGTH=0.55

# Texture resolution. 4096 is worth it with detail on; drop 
# to 2048 for a much smaller download if gzweb is slow to 
# load a site.
IMAGERY_SIZE=4096

# --- Fleet ------------------------------------------------
# One line per asset you control: ASSET_N=type,name,lat,lon
#   type   copter | plane | boat | rover | tower
#   name   MUST be one of the roles declared in
#          docker-compose.yml: quadcopter, fixed-wing, boat,
#          tower-1, tower-2
#   lat,lon  right-click in the sim and copy "lat,lon".
#            Prefix with xy: for world metres. Leave blank
#            to auto-place on suitable ground.
#
# Each role has its own container and its own IP, so every
# asset answers on ArduPilot's stock ports at its address:
#   quadcopter 10.23.0.100   host tcp 5760  udp 14550
#   fixed-wing 10.23.0.101   host tcp 5770  udp 14560
#   boat       10.23.0.102   host tcp 5780  udp 14570
#   tower-1    10.23.0.103   host tcp 5790  udp 14580
#   tower-2    10.23.0.104   host tcp 5800  udp 14590
# The address follows the ROLE, not the ASSET_N number, so
# reordering these lines never moves an asset's endpoint.
# A role with no line here runs an idle container.
#
# Towers are ArduPilot AntennaTracker instances: pan and tilt
# are SERVO1/SERVO2, driven over MAVLink like any other vehicle.
#
# The target vessel is NOT here — it is what teams have to
# find, so it stays under SHIP_* below with no MAVLink endpoint.
ASSET_1=copter,quadcopter,71.995807,-94.839300
ASSET_2=tower,tower-1,71.980671,-94.853711
ASSET_3=plane,fixed-wing,71.998195,-94.841967,>71.997790,-94.846245
ASSET_5=tower,tower-2,72.011778,-94.804721

# --- Vehicle --------------------------------------------

# Firmwares compiled into the SITL image. Each adds build 
# time; trim if youonly fly one type.
SITL_VEHICLES=copter rover plane antennatracker

# --- Performance ------------------------------------------
# Gazebo step rate AND ArduPilot's SCHED_LOOP_RATE; the 
# two must match or SITL reports "Main loop slow" and refuses 
# to arm. 250 suits a laptop. Raise both (400 is ArduCopter's 
# default) if your machine keeps up.
# --- Rendering ------------------------------------------
# There is no GPU in the container, so every camera is
# rasterised on the CPU by llvmpipe. Each live camera costs
# roughly a core. CAMERAS=0 leaves the sensors asleep until
#   live      always rendering (~1 core each)
#   ondemand  asleep until a feed is opened
#   off       no stream at all; the panel button greys out
CAMERAS=live
# Ogre re-renders the scene per light per frame for shadows.
SHADOWS=0

PHYSICS_RATE=250

# ArduPilot SCHED_LOOP_RATE. MUST be below PHYSICS_RATE, never equal: the FDM
# exchange is a synchronous round trip, so SITL always lands under the world
# rate. Equal values give "PreArm: Main loop slow" and nothing arms.
LOOP_RATE=150
SPEEDUP=1

# --- Ports -------------------------------------------------
GZWEB_PORT=8080
CONTROL_PORT=8090

# --- Rebuild switches ---------------------------------------
# FORCE_TERRAIN=1   re-download and rebuild terrain even if the 
# world exists GZWEB_REDEPLOY=1  re-run gzweb asset conversion 
# on next start
IMAGERY_SOURCE=mapbox

# --- Target: Ship --------------------------------------------

# Target vessel: SHIP places one, SHIP_MOVING sends it along 
# a planned course.
SHIP=1
SHIP_MOVING=1
SHIP_SPEED=3.0
# fixed  = always the same start (reproducible)
# random = seeded random start; for a moving vessel this is 
#          a point along the already-validated course, so the 
#          track never crosses land either way.
SHIP_START=random

# --- Weather --------------------------------------------
# Fog is rendered by Gazebo into CAMERA SENSORS, so it genuinely 
# degrades what a drone sees — not just the human view. Visibility 
# is roughly 3/density metres:
#   0.0008 -> ~3.7 km (light haze)   
#   0.0015 -> ~2 km   0.005 -> ~600 m (thick)
FOG=0
FOG_DENSITY=0.0008
FOG_COLOUR=0.80 0.84 0.88
FOG_TYPE=exp2
# Mapbox token — .env is gitignored.
MAPBOX_TOKEN=<redacted by scripts/arena_site.py>
CONTROL_BIND=0.0.0.0
GZWEB_ASSET_MAX_AGE=300

# --- Registry ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull the built images from ECR instead of rebuilding them here. Unset (as on a
# developer machine) the same compose files build locally under these exact
# names, so this is the only line that differs. See infra registry.tf.

REGISTRY=513676987015.dkr.ecr.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/ddc2-arctic-sim/
